name: lsimons-template-doc
comment:overrides: Security floors for transitive deps. Each is the patched release on the
SAME major the consumers already require, so no consumer sees a breaking
change: nanoid 3.x for postcss (4+ is ESM-only), js-yaml 4.x for astro and
starlight, fast-uri 3.x for ajv. Drop an entry once every consumer's own
range has moved past the floor and `bun audit` stays clean without it.
The fast-uri floor is 3.1.6 for GHSA-5jgf-p345-68v8, GHSA-f65p-4m7j-42xc,
The js-yaml floor is 4.3.2 for GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh. devalue 5.x (astro)
is floored at 5.9.2 for GHSA-9rgm-9g3h-6x36; svgo 4.x (astro) at 4.1.0
fast-uri is raised to 3.1.8 for GHSA-hrr3-gc8f-f4qj. http-cache-semantics
4.x (astro) is floored at 4.3.0 for GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp (OSV lists 4.2.0 as
last affected, no fixed version). smol-toml 1.x (astro) at 1.9.0 for
1.2.2 for GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q. postcss-selector-parser is NOT floored: its
fix is 7.x and postcss-nested 6.x requires ^6; see osv-scanner.toml.
